evals.prompt: I'm putting together a state-of-the-field review on GeoAI foundation models — pretrained/self-supervised models for satellite and aerial imagery. Can you build me a landscape analysis: pull recent work, figure out what's actually relevant, and give me a detailed report plus a 2-page synthesis I can hand to my director?
evals.expected_output: Elicits/confirms a theme description and a dimension rubric, writes the rubric to the manifest, invokes the Phase A tool to collect, curates (status + relevance_score + rationale on every record) via apply_curation.py without touching objective fields, fills dimensions and clusters, then produces a Full Report (grouped by cluster, consistent dimension table) and a <=2-page synthesis organized by dimension/cluster. No fabricated resources.

evals.prompt: We already ran a landscape analysis on 'Agents for Science' a couple months ago — the manifest is at agents-for-science/manifest.json. Refresh it: grab anything new since then, but don't redo the curation I already signed off on. I want to see exactly what changed.
evals.expected_output: Runs the tool in --update mode, scores only the new (status: raw) records, preserves prior curated/dropped decisions and dimensions, re-clusters only if needed, regenerates both reports, and produces a delta block listing added / dropped / changed-by-dimension. Agent-owned fields on pre-existing resources are unchanged.

evals.prompt: Here's a manifest.json from our collection tool with about 40 raw resources in it. Go through it and tell me which ones are actually worth including for a review on 'agents for scientific discovery', with a one-line reason for each keep/drop. Then organize the keepers into themes.
evals.expected_output: Reads the manifest, scores relevance for each raw resource with a one-line rationale, sets status curated/dropped via apply_curation.py (objective fields untouched), assigns cluster_ids, and presents the keep/drop decisions grouped into clusters. Every decision has a rationale; nothing is left undecided.
